body:
Food raises happiness (one need).
- Eats from the home bowl.
- Takes food from your hand.
- Favourite food: the very-happy move plays after.
Unknown: the game has no pet-eating move today (only the player eats).

comments.text:
Done: eats from the home bowl, takes food from your hand, happy dance after.
Player is a stand-in (farmer model).

short: Eats from the bowl and your hand. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: gap check against the stage briefs
title: Pet eats: bowl and your hand
